project: Ralph Effect Migration - Phase 5: Testing & Integration

features.description: Error type tests verify _tag discriminator and catchTag matching
steps: Open src/errors/index.test.ts
Verify tests for each error type exist
Check _tag property assertions
Verify Effect.catchTag matching works correctly

features.description: Stream tests verify parseNDJSON handles valid JSON, empty lines, and invalid JSON
steps: Open src/streams/ndjson.test.ts
Verify test for valid NDJSON parsing
Check test for empty line filtering
Verify test for StreamError on invalid JSON

features.description: ConfigTest mock layer provides test configuration values
steps: Open src/layers/test/ConfigTest.ts
Verify Layer.succeed provides mock ConfigService
Check all required config fields have test values
Verify layer can be used in test composition

features.description: DockerTest mock layer simulates container operations
steps: Open src/layers/test/DockerTest.ts
Verify Layer.succeed provides mock DockerService
Check exec returns predictable responses based on command
Verify create/start/remove return Effect.succeed
features.verification: test -f src/layers/test/DockerTest.ts && grep -q 'Layer.succeed' src/layers/test/DockerTest.ts && grep -q 'DockerService' src/layers/test/DockerTest.ts

features.description: ClaudeTest, GitTest, and DashboardTest mock layers are created
steps: Verify src/layers/test/ClaudeTest.ts exists with mock run/runWithEvents
Verify src/layers/test/GitTest.ts exists with mock git operations
Verify src/layers/test/DashboardTest.ts exists with mock state management
features.verification: test -f src/layers/test/ClaudeTest.ts && test -f src/layers/test/GitTest.ts && test -f src/layers/test/DashboardTest.ts

features.description: TestLive layer composition combines all mock layers for integration testing
steps: Open src/layers/test/index.ts
Verify TestLive exports composed mock layers
Check it can be used with Effect.provide in tests

features.description: Program integration tests verify mainLoop completes when all features pass
steps: Open src/program.test.ts
Verify test uses TestLive layer
Check test asserts mainLoop completes successfully
Verify Effect.runPromise is used for test execution

features.description: ralph.ts is updated to be a thin wrapper that delegates to src/main.ts
steps: Open ralph.ts
Verify it imports and runs the Effect-based implementation
Check backwards compatibility for CLI usage is maintained
Test 'bun ralph.ts --help' still works

features.description: CLAUDE.md documents the new Effect architecture patterns
steps: Open CLAUDE.md
Verify Effect patterns section exists (services, layers, errors)
Check file locations table is updated with new structure
Verify commands section still works
features.verification: grep -q 'Effect' CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'Layer' CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'services' CLAUDE.md

features.description: All tests pass and typecheck succeeds for the complete Effect migration
steps: Run 'bun run typecheck' - should succeed
Run 'bun test' - all tests should pass
Verify no TypeScript errors in src/ directory
